mapper.insert: INSERT INTO passkey_bootstrap_confirmation_token (user_id, token_hash, session_primary_id, expires_at, requested_ip) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{sessionPrimaryId}, DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL #{expiryMinutes} MINUTE), #{requestedIp})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, token_hash, session_primary_id, expires_at, consumed_at, requested_ip, created_at FROM passkey_bootstrap_confirmation_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP()
mapper.update: UPDATE passkey_bootstrap_confirmation_token SET consumed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND consumed_at IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM passkey_bootstrap_confirmation_token WHERE expires_at < UTC_TIMESTAMP() OR consumed_at IS NOT NULL
